description: PR14931 browser diagnostic. Reviewed against the generated plan, seeded fixture, and actual authenticated UI. The expected policy diagnostic must be visible; a bare missing-model error is a failure even if the legacy build API contains the note.

journeys.title: PR14931: browser explains restricted Agent substitution
journeys.goal: Understand why an imported customized Agent cannot build
journeys.because: the restricted server replaces saved code with its built-in Agent

state: The isolated database contains seeded flow 13200400-ae45-4b43-ba75-7d3ce7c8a8fe, named PR14931 Customized Agent Diagnostic. It retains a customized Agent schema without the stock model input. The seed script and source JSON are in the sibling runtime directory. Do not update or repair the node before testing.

steps.do: Navigate to / in the fresh browser.
steps.see: The Langflow sign-in form is visible.

steps.do: Fill Username with ${LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER}, Password with ${LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD}, and submit Sign In once.
steps.see: The authenticated projects dashboard is visible and the sign-in form has disappeared.
The Customized Agent Diagnostic node is visible, with a Run component control and no Language Model input.

steps.do: Activate Run component once and read the resulting visible build error. Do not retry, update, or repair the node.
steps.see: The error visibly explains all three facts: custom components are disabled (LANGFLOW_ALLOW_CUSTOM_COMPONENTS=false); the server's built-in Agent replaced the saved component code; the saved schema lacks the required model input. A bare No model selected message without the policy explanation does not satisfy this expectation.
